result.summary: The image shows a narrow urban residential street with high-visibility continental crosswalks and painted curb extensions. The environment is generally pedestrian-friendly with wide sidewalks and street trees, though it relies primarily on paint rather than physical infrastructure for traffic calming.

hazards.name: Visual obstruction from parked vehicles
hazards.description: Parked cars along the curb may obstruct the view between drivers and pedestrians waiting to cross, despite the painted daylighting zones.
hazards.location_in_image: Along the curbs approaching the intersection on both sides of the street.

interventions.title: Raised Crosswalk
interventions.description: Elevate the crosswalk to the level of the sidewalk to physically slow traffic and increase pedestrian visibility.

interventions.title: Concrete Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Replace painted curb extensions with permanent concrete structures to physically shorten crossing distance and prevent illegal parking in daylighting zones.

result.summary: The street features a well-marked zebra crosswalk and a green-painted bike lane in a residential setting. While sidewalks and curb ramps are present, the crossing lacks vertical traffic calming or active signals to ensure pedestrian safety against potentially speeding vehicles.

hazards.name: Uncontrolled Crossing
hazards.description: The marked crosswalk lacks stop signs or signals, relying entirely on driver compliance at a point of conflict.
hazards.location_in_image: Center foreground at the zebra crossing

hazards.name: Potential Sightline Obstruction
hazards.description: Parked vehicles along the curb upstream from the crossing may limit the visibility of pedestrians to approaching drivers.
hazards.location_in_image: Left side of the street, background

interventions.title: Curb Extensions (Bulb-outs)
interventions.description: Extend the sidewalk into the parking lane to shorten crossing distance and improve visibility between pedestrians and drivers.

interventions.title: Raised Crosswalk
interventions.description: Elevate the crosswalk to the level of the sidewalk to act as a speed table and increase pedestrian visibility.

interventions.title: Daylighting
interventions.description: Remove parking spaces immediately adjacent to the crosswalk to ensure clear sightlines for all road users.

result.summary: The image shows a residential street with a marked zebra crosswalk and sidewalks on both sides. While a low speed limit is posted for a school zone, the wide roadway and parked cars near the crossing create potential visibility and speed issues for pedestrians.

hazards.name: Faded Crosswalk Markings
hazards.description: The zebra markings are worn, reducing their visibility to approaching motorists.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Markings
